violated_contract: A chat citation number must name exactly one collected record for the whole turn. Citation [k] resolves to the k-th card the turn collected, so a producer that numbers a record from the collector's length and appends its card later can give two records the same number when parallel tool calls run on separate threads, and a record returned by two tool calls gets two numbers and two cards. The answer then attaches the wrong or a duplicated source card, and those ids are persisted on the message.
canonical_prevention: Number a record and append its card in one critical section over the turn's collector, keyed by record id so a record shown again keeps its first number. A behavioral test renders the same record from two reads and two records from concurrent reads, then checks that every shown number resolves to its own record.
